scope: Current application routes, visible workflow screens, controllers/validation, services and feature tests. This inventory supports Help Centre maintenance; it is not a claim that every project test was run in this pass.

role_access.approved_association_applicant: All four Help Centre sections; association data still resolved and authorized by each destination.
role_access.pending_representative: Profile help only; management sections and downloads return 404.
role_access.verified_individual: Existing Help Centre returns 403; member-facing behavior is documented for association support without widening access.
role_access.platform_reviewer: Configured independent review/audit permissions; not automatically association finance owner.

limits: Legacy import is preview-only; no member or sequence writes.
Invoice reminder delivery is fake-mail-only; no live sending or reminder schedule.
Recurring generation has a Laravel daily registration, but this work does not enable a production scheduler.

Accounts reported a successful TallyPrime 7.2 import with no errors. Per-ledger reconciliation and repeat-import behavior remain pending unless separately evidenced; this help review did not independently witness the import.
No database reset, migrations, import write phase, push or deployment in this help pass.
Workspace/master edits require PIN enrollment, a session unlock and a resource lease. Ordinary financial work remains available.
Three additive workspace/mail/tax migrations applied only to filmunity_test in this feature pass; development/production untouched.
Live SMTP/provider and browser/PDF/mobile verification remain manual. Recurring invoices remain non-tax drafts; tax setup versioning does not automate legal applicability.
infrastructure: Fortify/passkey/authentication and settings routes are covered by profile/account-settings. Framework storage, health, devtools and CSRF routes are infrastructure, not separate user data-entry articles. API V1 currently exposes health only.
